name: Stocking Name Tag
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Best Material: Made of wooden and acrylic for each of layer
  • The Multi-functional of the stocking name tags includes:

Identification: The primary function of stocking name tags is to identify whose stocking belongs to whom in a family or group. They ensure that each person receives the right gifts or treats.

Personalization: Stocking name tags can be personalized with individual names, making them a decorative and personal touch to holiday decorations.

Decoration: These name tags often come in various festive designs, colors, and materials. They add to the overall holiday decor, making stockings look more attractive and in tune with the holiday spirit.

Organization: Name tags help in organizing gifts and treats. They can specify the recipient's name, making it easier to keep track of what's intended for each person.

Keepsakes: Some families use stocking name tags year after year. These tags become keepsakes and part of cherished holiday traditions.

Craft Projects: Stocking name tags can be used as craft projects, especially for children. They can decorate and personalize their own name tags, adding a creative element to the holiday festivities.

Learning Tool: For young children who are learning to read, stocking name tags can serve as a helpful tool to identify their names.

Gift Tags: In addition to stockings, these name tags can double as gift tags for other presents. This adds a cohesive look to your holiday gift presentation.

Customization: Design will be printed  by our UV printed technology.

Gift of love: A perfect idea for everyone who finds a Christmas gift for your family or friends. You can gift it to your favorite celebrities, friends, family members, and lovers.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Stocking Name Tag

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.5-2 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 

 

  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

 

  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.

 

  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.

 

  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.

 

  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.

 

  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.

 

  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

 

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.

 

  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
